name: Craigdarroch Castle
scope: The standing Craigdarroch Castle masonry mansion in Victoria, including the round tower, open carriage porch, steep slate roof, dormers and attached bays.
era: Standing 1887–1890 house and maintenance of its original external form.

originalReview.notes: Exact original photographer upload under CC0, showing the carriage entrance, circular tower, steep red slate, the flank chimneys and arched carriage entrance.

review.method: Exactly matched public-domain originals, native building footprint and published architectural dimensions.
review.notes: Examined the Qualla-published original records first. The exterior labeled public domain is a transferred file with its original source field empty. The explicit CC0 interior panorama is not an exterior reference, and the other exterior photos have attribution conditions. Used the publisher-photographer’s unedited and explicitly CC0 exterior file.
